title: Lubbuu Dammaqaa qarqara Lagaa
intro: Lubbuun dargaggeessa tokko ergama dhoksaa, yeroo hiree bishaan irratti mul’atu fageenya nageenya qabu irraa ilaaluuf imaanaa itti kenname. Lakkoofsi kun osoo hin mul’annee fi hin shakkamne adeemsa seenaa saba tokkoo jijjiiruu keessatti gahee olaanaa qaba ture.
clues: Hojii dhoksaa fi dammaqina barbaadu haadha kootu naaf kenname.
Ijji koo, onneen koo yaaddoo irraa kan kaʼe ulfaataa taʼee, siree xinnoo kaarentii sana keessa yaaʼu hordofe.
Dhaaba hin eegamneen yeroo argatu, rifachuudhaan guutamee itti dhihaadhe.
Kunuunsituu tokkoof abdii kutachuu isaanii argeen dhugaa jiru osoo hin mul'isin furmaata dhiheesse.
Yeroodhaan gidduu seenuun koo lubbuu hoosistuu gara isa baay’ee isa barbaachisutti deebiseera.
Manneen murtii namoota humna qaban keessatti akkas jedheen dubbadhe: ‘Maatii isa sooruu fi of eeggannoodhaan isa ilaalutti si qajeelchaa?’ jedheen dubbadhe.

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
